description: This file is a PHP script for the SuiteCRM dashboard page, responsible for loading user preferences, managing dashlets, handling caching, and rendering the dashboard interface with Smarty templates.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: A class for managing individual dashlet behavior and display.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty extension for rendering the dashboard interface.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a dashlet is permitted to be displayed based on user permissions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the dashlet.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header content for the dashlet.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer content for the dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code needed by the dashlet.

methods.name: hasScript
methods.description: Property indicating if the dashlet has associated script.
